g.text: OffPageForm: what the page doesn't draw
Accent, Kicker, the recording, the website
the CV drawn, a band per
ResumeChanged: listened for, it is edited in place
IResumeSource: the API, or the host's file

text.tspan: The site holds only its words, places, demos and diagrams:
the pages sit on the framework's shell, each diagram is data held to the code by a test. Its CV is one record, drawn by
one view that the admin edits where it stands.
